sloka: कच्चिन्न तद्धेमसमानवर्णं तस्याननं पद्मसमानगन्धि ।मया विना शुष्यति शोकदीनं जलक्षये पद्ममिवातपेन ।। ५.३६.२८।।।।
transliteration: kaccinna taddhemasamānavarṇaṁ tasyānanaṁ padmasamānagandhi ।mayā vinā śuṣyati śokadīnaṁ jalakṣaye padmamivātapena ।। 5.36.28।।।।

translations.english: "Hope, Rama's moonlike face without me with its golden complexion and lotus fragrance must not have been pale and withered with tears like the lotus in a pond scorched by the heat.
